verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a government register and filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence covers register search, coverage and a publication platform for submitting orders. Nothing in it describes authorization forms, third-party roles, or which signatures must remain personal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
